name: slashed-for-wp
description: SLASHED for WordPress — Bricks Builder and Gutenberg integrations for the SLASHED cascade-layer CSS framework.
author: jackgranatowski

scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks && chmod +x .githooks/* || true
scripts.build:data: node scripts/gen-bricks-inventory.js && node scripts/gen-class-hints.js && node scripts/gen-variables-hints.js
scripts.build:admin-app: (cd SLASHED-for-WP/admin-app && npm ci && npm run build)
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:editor-app && npm run build:admin-app
scripts.build: npm run build:data && npm run sync-dist && npm run build:apps && npm run build:zip
scripts.lint: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:php
